legacy.decisive_log: legacy parity baseline passed (3 real-boundary scenarios)

requirements.text: A strict TypeScript-first architecture defines shared domain contracts across adapters, runtime, persistence, control plane, CLI, and web UI.
Harness adapters translate Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and supported backend/model capabilities into versioned canonical contracts.
One durable control-plane model owns identity, generations, endpoint fencing, lifecycle, activity semantics, readiness, and diagnostics.
Registration, lifecycle changes, crash recovery, and projections behave deterministically across supported harnesses.
The compact launcher has deterministic precedence, presets, capability validation, concise output, diagnostics, and non-recursive invocation.
Dashboard, sessions, tracker, controls, CLI, and diagnostics consume typed APIs and materialized views.
The dashboard has an accessible design system, bounded responsive layouts, and light/dark/system themes.
Existing data and integrations have dry-run migration, compatibility, observable cutover, and nondestructive rollback.
Delivery is staged behind parity and migration gates and each wave remains runnable.
Verification uses real SQLite, processes, services, concurrency, reordering, duplicate delivery, crashes, restart, migration, launch UX, and UI states.
Repository structure, decisions, contributor workflow, generated boundaries, and invariants are documented.
Deep design documents, ADRs, component/data-flow, migration, and dependency-ordered implementation planning exist.
Builder briefs retain parent, ADR, predecessor, acceptance, workspace, and non-goal context.
The replacement demonstrates retained parity, GOL-6 lifecycle consistency, and GOL-11 launcher truth.

parity.cutover_gate: Temporary-home health and dashboard projection journey.
Version/fingerprint fail-closed, restart, duplicate-envelope, and TUI-thread journey.
Render, registration, and pull-only capability journey.
Temporary render, tamper, refresh, and rollback journey.
Authenticated channel and model-consumption qualification journey.
Config validation, resume/child identity, retry, deletion, and source-independent render journey.
Inbox replay, acknowledgement, dead-letter, and next-turn journey.
Nested Git, common-dir worktree, relocation, and forbidden-root journey.
Generation, ordering, stale-event, and endpoint-fence journey.
Inbox rename, replay-once, and quarantine journey.
Real SQLite tracker migration and phase/idempotency journey.
Busy/waiting/pull/next-turn, retry, ack deadline, and owner-fence journey.
UUID dedupe, cursor ordering, offline replay, and passive-consumption journey.
Role activation, human-gate audit, idea promotion, and redaction journey.
Preset precedence, dry-run redaction, direct-mode truth, and qualified Claude/Ollama consumption journey.

retirements.reason: install, cleanup, reinstall, session, project, dispatch, and ack are absent current v3 commands.
JSON registries remain import/export inputs until C4 and must not become canonical authority.
agents-update, tickets-update, agent-detail, and orchestrator-update are removed v3 projection messages.

residual_risks.disposition: Unsupported unless the correct native prebuild or cached compiler toolchain is present.
No credentialed capability is fabricated; absent binaries, models, daemons, or consumption evidence remain unavailable or pull-only/not-ready before spawn.
The same candidate has real x64 Node/addon/SQLite evidence under Rosetta; an independent physical x64 runner remains release-infrastructure hardening.
